title: Part (2 parts)
spec: Create a new coordinate system for the first part, setting the Euler angles to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and the translation vector to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, creating a single loop and within that loop, draw a circle. Position the center of the circle at [0.0789, 0.0789] and set the radius to 0.0789. Apply a scale factor of 0.1579 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the sketch into three-dimensional space using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.1579 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This will create a new solid body with final dimensions of length 0.15789473684210523 units, width 0.15789473684210523 units, and height 0.15789473684210525 units. For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and a translation vector [0.073, 0.073, 0.1579]. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, creating a single loop and within that loop, draw a circle. Position the center of the circle at [0.0059, 0.0059] and set the radius to 0.0059. Apply a scale factor of 0.0118 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the sketch into three-dimensional space using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and the translation vector [0.073, 0.073, 0.1579]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.5921 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Add the extruded shape to the existing body, resulting in a final dimension of length 0.011842105263157893 units, width 0.011842105263157893 units, and height 0.5921052631578947 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0789, 0.0789)
    .circle(0.0789)
    .extrude(0.1579)
)

# Create the rod
rod = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0059, 0.0059)
    .circle(0.0059)
    .extrude(0.5921)
    .translate((0.073, 0.073, 0.1579))
)

# Combine the parts
r = cylinder.union(rod)

import cadquery as cq

# Bottom cylinder (plumb bob body)
body = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0789).extrude(0.159)

# Thin rod extending upward from the cylinder
rod = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=0.159).circle(0.003).extrude(0.591)

# Combine into the final part
r = body.union(rod)
